headline: Top 5 News for Monday: Possible Hryvnia Printing, UAH 19,000 for Heating, and the Most Profitable Banks
summary: Ukraine's Cabinet of Ministers re-approved two related draft laws on September 7, including VAT on parcels up to €150. Other items covered hryvnia printing and heating payments.
why: Import VAT and budget measures shape the cost of cross-border e-commerce and public finances. Investors watch these rules for their effect on retail, logistics and sovereign budgets.
